mapper.select: SELECT t.tdm55_row_num AS row_num , t.tdm55_upd_date_str AS upd_date_str , t.tdm55_proc_type AS proc_type , t.tdm55_person_info AS person_info , t.tdm55_proc_result AS proc_result , t.tdm55_result_cmnt AS result_cmnt FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY tdm55_upd_date) AS tdm55_row_num , tdm55_chck_record.* , COALESCE(TO_CHAR(tdm55_upd_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), '') AS tdm55_upd_date_str FROM tdm55_chck_record WHERE tdm55_relate_table_id IN ( SELECT tdm62_chck_appr_cmnt_id FROM tdm62_chck_cmnt_relate_org INNER JOIN tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt ON tdm59_chck_appr_cmnt_id = tdm62_chck_appr_cmnt_id WHERE tdm62_chck_org_id = #{chckOrgId} ) ) t ORDER BY t.tdm55_row_num DESC

SELECT t.tdm55_row_num AS row_num , t.tdm55_upd_date_str AS upd_date_str , t.tdm55_proc_type AS proc_type , t.tdm55_person_info AS person_info , t.tdm55_proc_result AS proc_result , t.tdm55_result_cmnt AS result_cmnt FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY tdm55_upd_date) AS tdm55_row_num , tdm55_chck_record.* , COALESCE(TO_CHAR(tdm55_upd_date, 'yyyy-mm-dd HH24:MI:SS'), '') AS tdm55_upd_date_str FROM tdm55_chck_record WHERE tdm55_relate_table_id = #{relateId} ) t ORDER BY t.tdm55_row_num DESC

SELECT company_id FROM ( SELECT tdm52_company_id AS company_id FROM tdm52_chck_manl WHERE tdm52_chck_manl_id = #{relateId} UNION ALL SELECT tdm54_company_id AS company_id FROM tdm54_chck_insuff WHERE tdm54_chck_insuff_id = #{relateId} ) t LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tdm55_chck_record ( tdm55_chck_record_id, tdm55_relate_table_id, tdm55_relate_table, tdm55_proc_type, tdm55_person_id, tdm55_person_info, tdm55_proc_result, tdm55_result_cmnt, tdm55_report_cmnt, tdm55_upd_date ) SELECT f_create_seq() , #{row.relateTableId} , #{row.relateTable} , #{row.procType} , #{row.personId} , CONCAT( emp00_kor_nm , ' '||f_cdnm('EmpPosCode', emp00_pos_cd, #{row.companyId}, CAST(#{row.stdDate} AS date)) , '('||emp00_org_code_nm||')' ) , NULL , NULL , NULL , f_sysdate() FROM getPerson(#{row.companyId}, CAST(#{row.stdDate} AS date)) WHERE emp00_person_id = #{row.personId}
